context: Synthetic fixture first, then the complete public Amazon graph and prospectively permitted S/R labels with a fresh fixed native state; no fitting, A labels, VALID, TEST or outcome-selected states
before_execution: Verify exact native/adapter/operator source bytes, installed Torch/PyG/scatter versions, complete parameter names and shapes; bind the separate safe public/B-only caller
Bind fixed numerical tolerances, directional vectors and scales before executing; preserve every failure and measured cost; no retry through changed algebra or tolerance
Keep all 24492 model nodes, native full edges with loops, fixed global stage and eval mode; snapshot parameter/storage aliases, all module modes/attributes/buffers and CPU/CUDA RNG

checks.name: native_one_member_reconstruction
checks.required: For every m=0..3 compare all N×5 callback logits with frozen family.forward_member(...,m), and once with the complete native bank reference. Check callback invokes exactly one member trajectory. Compare complete theta and selected phi own-CE gradients against the original selected member/bank-row gradients; other bank rows zero. Test global and local stage identities; inactive head factors/weights must be exactly disconnected/zero and unchanged. Restore the candidate's fixed global binding afterwards.

checks.name: sparse_dense_map_identity
checks.required: On a fixed synthetic graph with both class directions, isolates, cross-label edges and duplicate/self-loop rejection, compare K restriction, max degree, LQ, every one of eight Q iterates, raw cost normalization, all private response values, outer loss and complete derivatives with repaired dense G0V2. On the full graph compare every sparse LQ against a separately coalesced constant sparse-matrix product and verify all pair supports/norms; do not densify full native affinity. Include the frozen within-class permutation orientation, gamma0 and uniform cases.

checks.name: independent_full_chain
checks.required: Separate theta, original phi, independent Q leaves and adapted private leaves. Obtain direct query theta gradient and every private query cotangent. Form -eta_private times the private-gradient mixed theta VJP and Q cotangent with Q independent. Propagate that Q cotangent through the complete preliminary own-CE response, centered RMS and eight sparse assignment steps. Compare direct+mixed+Q-chain with torch.func shared derivative for EVERY named theta coordinate and per-name norm; no coordinates or native blocks may be omitted. Verify private partial equals independent-fixed-Q derivative, not the total phi derivative through Q.

checks.name: full_sparse_directional_checks
checks.required: Use prospectively fixed directions spanning every active theta block, plus a selected complete-private direction for response reconstruction; no numerical/RNG mutation inside the callback. For multiple fixed central-difference scales, recompute the WHOLE virtual outer objective at theta±h*d from identical original phi/public context, including native GAT/global attention, probe, RMS, all eight sparse steps and main partial. Compare directional finite difference with dot(full shared derivative,d); retain scale dependence/ReLU crossing/noise. Also verify stopped-Q equals the derivative with forward Q fixed at the identical start and has equal Q/private/query values. The small tensor fixture's success does not substitute for these full native checks.

checks.name: feasible_state_and_commit
checks.required: Check finite response/cost/gradients, every pair's two label supports, positive Q, row sums1, member sums n_pair/4, all eight objective descents within fixed floating tolerances, and diagnostic departure from uniform. Compare theta+ and recomputed phi+ against independent SGD equations using original phi; stale virtual/probe values must not be committed. Reconstruct committed serving logits and probability mean. Require callback/episode leave donor parameters, modes, buffers/attributes, feature/edge inputs and RNG unchanged. Charge full peak memory/time and stop before scientific acquisition if native higher-order or resource checks fail.
